pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Large, predominantly polygonal dark brown regions on the neck and shoulder with distinct, relatively sharp edge gradients; transitioning to smaller, more irregular, and rounded shapes toward the lower flank and forelimb.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: A well-defined network of light-colored interstitial pathways forming tri-radial and quadri-radial junction nodes; pathway thickness is greatest on the neck and narrows significantly toward the ventral and posterior regions.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: A continuous mane of short, vertical hairs creating a jagged silhouette with consistent, low-amplitude serration along the dorsal neck line.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a small avian organism (oxpecker) clinging to the mid-lower neck; a second avian organism is visible in the background near the posterior dorsal line.
